return-not-in-function: FALSE POSITIVE - the rule mis-reads Python lambda expressions as a bare return; no return statement exists outside a function (verified; interpreter would raise SyntaxError).
string-concat-in-list: ACCEPTED - intentional line-wrapped string literals (long help/finding text). No missing commas: every affected line is exercised by the test suite.
dangerous-subprocess-use-audit: ACCEPTED (test and developer-tool code only) - tests launch this project's own CLI/tools, and tools/zap_local.py launches the developer's own ZAP/Java, with fixed argument lists, shell=False, no tenant or user data in the command.
unknown-value-with-script-tag: FALSE POSITIVE (test code only) - Node test shim reads our own generated report HTML to run the filter script; it is not browser code.
eval-detected: ACCEPTED (test code only) - the Node shim evaluates the report's own filter script (generated by this project) under a fake DOM to unit-test filtering.
changed-semgrepignore: INFORMATIONAL - the project .semgrepignore overrides semgrep's default (which would skip tests/). It excludes only generated scan outputs (docs/security, docs/screenshots) and __pycache__.
contains-bidirectional-characters: ACCEPTED (test code only) - tests/fuzz.py deliberately contains a right-to-left override string as a hostile-input payload to prove reports render it as inert text.
arbitrary-sleep: ACCEPTED (test code only) - tests/uat_gui.py waits for the Tk event loop in a polling loop with a bounded timeout; no production code sleeps this way.
dynamic-urllib-use-detected: FIXED - URL is restricted to https://learn.microsoft.com/ before any request; also marked nosemgrep with reason.
use-defused-xml: ACCEPTED - entra_scan/export.py imports ElementTree only to BUILD the JUnit document from our own data (ET.tostring escapes all text and attributes); nothing untrusted is ever parsed with it, so the XML-parsing attacks defusedxml defends against (entity expansion, XXE) do not apply. Test code imports it to parse our own output. A fuzz/unit test (test_junit_is_well_formed_and_escapes_hostile_names) proves hostile names stay inert.
use-defused-xml-parse: ACCEPTED (test/UAT code only) - tests/uat.py parses the JUnit file this tool just wrote itself, to check it is well-formed.
unspecified-open-encoding: ACCEPTED (test code only) - UAT script opens its own JSON output; ASCII/UTF-8 only.
private-key: FALSE POSITIVE - tools/setup_app_registration.ps1 contains only the literal PEM header/footer text used to wrap a key the script generates at run time; no key material is stored in the repository.
dangerous-subprocess-use-tainted-env-arg: ACCEPTED (developer tool only) - tools/zap_local.py takes the ZAP and Java locations from the developer's own ZAP_HOME / ZAP_JAVA / LOCALAPPDATA; list arguments, shell=False, never run by the scanner itself.
